header:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: single finished wide illustrated forum masthead, landscape aspect ratio 2.25:1.
Primary request: Create an exquisitely illustrated, decorative FLAT graphic masthead for a magical Hufflepuff potions gazette. The title is exactly "The Practical Potioneer", with the much smaller subtitle "Практика зельеделия". This is an illustrated storybook/apothecary journal, with contemporary sophisticated composition and decorative Arts and Crafts botanical printmaking. A skilled human illustrator's playful, literate, slightly eccentric work. NOT a photorealistic image. NOT glossy. NOT thin-line geometric luxury branding.
Color palette MUST match a warm ivory-and-antique-gold forum theme: background light warm ivory #F5F1E0 and pale buttery cream #FBE BCC (i.e. #FBE BCC without spaces, approximately #FBECCC); broad ochre-gold #BB9039, mustard #C6A043, rich dark chocolate ink #493821, a little warm grey taupe. Use almost exclusively mustard yellow, paper cream and brown-black Hufflepuff colors. The overall image is LIGHT and warm.
Composition: generous central oval-ish open ivory area holds the title, beautifully drawn English lettering in an expressive slightly italic bold book-jacket serif, unmistakably readable at reduced size. Arrange "The Practical" on the first line and "Potioneer" larger on the second line, with much smaller Russian Cyrillic subtitle "Практика зельеделия" immediately below. All three lines centered. Enough breathing room.
Illustration: LEFT border and lower left corner have a flat charcoal-and-cream badger half hidden behind a bubbling ochre cauldron, simple mustard vapor curls, dried herb bunch and chamomile leaves. RIGHT border and lower right corner have three quirky flat illustrated apothecary bottles, a mortar and pestle, and little bold botanical sprigs and seed heads. Decorative leafy acanthus scrolls curl around top left and top right, some broad leaves shaped like little golden flames; asymmetrical organic rhythm. Very small decorative stars drawn as solid ink shapes. The ornamental scene frames the title but never crowds or intersects the letters.
Style/medium: gorgeous flat gouache/screenprint/linocut inspired illustration, confident substantial ink contours, tactile subtle paper speckle, broad solid areas of ochre, matte colors, irregular human hand-drawn charm. Decorative but clean. Elegant adult storybook almanac, not children's clipart or cutesy cartoon. Ornamental woodcut leaves with rounded details. Sharply legible bespoke typography. No thin alchemical orbits.
Text verbatim ONLY: "The Practical", "Potioneer", "Практика зельеделия". No asterisks printed. Exact spelling Potioneer (P o t i o n e e r). Cyrillic text must be correct. No other captions, labels, dates, logos, or watermarks.
Constraints: full bleed single flat horizontal banner, no mockup, no perspective, no book photographed, no 3D, no luminous gold smoke, no metallic effects, no black background, no gradients, no Art Deco straight-line geometry. Keep outermost background paper cream, not dark.
header_revision:
Use case: precise-object-edit / text-localization.
Input image: Image 1 is the exact existing masthead to edit.
Change ONLY the small Russian subtitle below "Potioneer". Replace the current italic mixed-case subtitle with the exact text "ПРАКТИКА ЗЕЛЬЕДЕЛИЯ".
Typography requirement for that subtitle: ALL UPPERCASE Cyrillic; straight UPRIGHT, absolutely NON-ITALIC; a VERY THIN, fine-weight clean sans-serif font, delicately and moderately letter-spaced. Both words uppercase. Keep it small, approximately the same line width as the old subtitle, on a single horizontal line. Dark brown ink, easy to read on cream paper. Think exceptionally light book colophon typography, never bold and never slanted.
Keep the big English title "The Practical Potioneer" and its original thick italic decorative serif EXACTLY unchanged. Preserve every illustration, badger, cauldron, herbal bottles, botanical ornaments, stars, paper texture, colors, layout and landscape aspect ratio unchanged. This is a local subtitle correction, not a redesign.
Exact replacement subtitle: П Р А К Т И К А [space] З Е Л Ь Е Д Е Л И Я — these letter-by-letter guides are not separate letters in the output: render normally as "ПРАКТИКА ЗЕЛЬЕДЕЛИЯ". No punctuation, no extra text, no asterisks.
